description:
Create a visualization of Newton's Method for finding roots. 

1. Define the function f(x) = x^3 - 2x - 5 (Newton's original example).
2. Compute its derivative f'(x) using GeoGebra's Derivative command.
3. Start the iteration at x0 = 3. Create a point A0 on the curve at x=3.
4. Construct the tangent line to f at A0.
5. Find the x-intercept of this tangent line (x1).
6. Create the next point A1 on the curve at x1.
7. Repeat this process for at least 3 iterations (finding x1, x2, x3).
8. Mark the approximate root on the x-axis.
9. Add a text annotation displaying the final approximate root value.

Save the project as 'newtons_method.ggb' in ~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/.
